import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp


@jax.jit
def score_prefixes(weights, states, lengths):
    columns = jnp.arange(weights.shape[1])

    def step(carry, length):
        mask = columns < length
        prefix_weights = jnp.where(mask[None, :], weights, 0)
        prefix_states = jnp.where(mask, states, 0)
        score = prefix_weights @ prefix_states
        return carry, score

    return jax.lax.scan(step, None, lengths)[1]

convergence-loop-raw:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp


@jax.jit
def power_iteration(matrix, initial, max_steps, tolerance):
    def condition(state):
        step, vector, converged = state
        return (step < max_steps) & ~converged

    def update(state):
        step, vector, converged = state
        candidate = matrix @ vector
        candidate = candidate / jnp.linalg.norm(candidate)
        delta = jnp.linalg.norm(candidate - vector)
        return step + 1, candidate, delta < tolerance

    _, vector, _ = jax.lax.while_loop(
        condition, update, (jnp.array(0), initial, jnp.array(False))
    )
    return vector
